doc.title: Louis Armstrong and Herman Chittison Interview, 1960-05-04

title: Film work, Joe Glaser, hotel interview and the Cuban bassist in Europe
summary: Armstrong talks about Sunnyside played on a film set, the number written for a film scene, being cut from a picture, concert life and a late-night New Orleans hotel interview, then his multinational European band.
